title: Counting the Coverage Months Reckoned as Owed on a Ridgecrest Advantage Premium Account
content:
On a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment, the coverage months reckoned as owed are counted from what stands on the premium account against how long the enrollment has been in force.

| Where the account and the enrollment show | The coverage months reckoned as owed |
| --- | --- |
| More plan premium charges stand on the premium account than the coverage months the enrollment has been in force | Counted as 1 for every plan premium charge standing on the account |
| The enrollment is billed quarterly and no more plan premium charges stand on the account than the coverage months it has been in force | Counted as 3 for every plan premium charge standing on the account |
| The enrollment is billed monthly and no more plan premium charges stand on the account than the coverage months it has been in force | The whole months that have passed since the coverage effective date, and one more for the month in hand |

The first row governs wherever the charges standing on the account outnumber the coverage months in force, whichever cadence the enrollment is billed on. The second and third rows are reached only where the charges standing on the account are no more numerous than those coverage months, and there the cadence decides between them.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

*An enrollment in force for 4 coverage months with 6 plan premium charges standing on the account.* The charges outnumber the coverage months, so the coverage months reckoned as owed are counted as 1 for every charge: 6.

*An enrollment billed quarterly, in force for 9 coverage months, with 2 plan premium charges standing on the account.* The charges do not outnumber the coverage months and the cadence is quarterly, so they are counted as 3 for every charge: 6.

*An enrollment billed monthly, in force since a coverage effective date of 1 February with a handling date of 10 April, and 1 plan premium charge standing on the account.* The charge does not outnumber the coverage months and the cadence is monthly, so the count is the whole months passed since 1 February, which is 2, and one more for the month in hand: 3.
